name: job-scout
description: job-scout — finds open jobs that fit your resume by reading employer job boards directly (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, SmartRecruiters, Workday; USAJOBS with your own free key), after you confirm a short search brief. Returns about 15 roles checked open today, linked straight to the employer, with fit reasons quoted from each job description. Best for tech and startup roles.

interface.shortDescription: Open roles that fit your resume, straight from employer job boards.
interface.longDescription: job-scout reads your resume, confirms a short search brief with you, then checks employer job boards directly and returns about 15 open roles with direct links and quoted fit reasons. Needs network access (run Codex with network access enabled).
defaultPrompt: Find open roles that fit my resume.
What should I apply to? Here is my CV.
Anything new since my last job search?
